card.summary: Free plan with encrypted storage, no card; '+25GB free' if you post a social-media review. Paid Personal from 100 GB; Business up to 2x storage in bandwidth.

free_tier.stated: Free plan with encrypted storage, no card; '+25GB free' if you post a social-media review. Paid Personal from 100 GB; Business up to 2x storage in bandwidth.

egress.terms: Monthly bandwidth ALLOWANCE, not free: 'up to 10GB on the Free plan', 'your chosen storage size on Personal', 'up to 2x your storage on Business'. Frequently-accessed files are cached so some traffic doesn't count.

record.tooling: API use is explicitly covered by the bandwidth allowance, implying a REST API; no rclone backend.
record.chaining: Free tier is ~10 GB bandwidth/month. The bandwidth allowance, not storage, is the binding constraint and it is tiny.
record.limits_note: Bandwidth is limited to 10 GB per month on the free plan.
record.reliability_note: The StackSocial 2 TB lifetime listing (f/18179782, $109.97) now 404s. The lifetime SKU line has been retired in favour of 'Folder Fort 2.0' subscriptions. Bandwidth-metered model is the opposite of the egress-free requirement.

evidence.proved: 'up to 10GB on the Free plan ... up to 2x your storage on Business ... refreshes automatically every month', fetched 2026-10-21

record.notes: Free plan with encrypted storage, no card; '+25GB free' if you post a social-media review. Paid Personal from 100 GB; Business up to 2x storage in bandwidth.

dead_end.why: Free plan with encrypted storage, no card; '+25GB free' if you post a social-media review. Paid Personal from 100 GB; Business up to 2x storage in bandwidth.

card.summary: Free plan exists with no credit card, size not published on the pricing page; free-plan bandwidth is 10 GB/month. Paid Personal starts at 100 GB, Business 1 TB.

free_tier.stated: Free plan exists with no credit card, size not published on the pricing page; free-plan bandwidth is 10 GB/month. Paid Personal starts at 100 GB, Business 1 TB.

egress.terms: Metered by monthly bandwidth allowance: 'up to 10GB on the Free plan, your chosen storage size on Personal (starting at 100GB), and up to 2x your storage on Business'. API/SFTP/WebDAV traffic counts against it.

record.interface_detail: sftp / webdav / rest (rclone) / s3-style via FF Connect
record.chaining: If the free storage number were large this would be a genuine finding because rclone/SFTP/WebDAV are all supported and 'all users, regardless of plan, receive free SFTP access'. But free bandwidth is 10 GB/month, so even a 500 GB free bucket could not be read out. Multiplication by accounts multiplies 10 GB/month each.
record.limits_note: per-ip-shaping/request-rate: 10 GB/month bandwidth on free (covers upload, download, streaming, embedding, share links and API use); API credits on Classic accounts are annual ('1 GB = up to 2 credits free annually'); free plan storage not stated; Classic access ends 2026-11-16.
record.reliability_note: Platform is mid-migration: 'Classic access ends November 16, 2026', free tier has already been re-scoped once this year; SFTP was still 'load testing' per its own docs.

evidence.proved: 'Yes. Sign up and you get free encrypted storage to try the platform — no credit card required', 'Every plan includes a monthly bandwidth allowance — up to 10GB on the Free plan ... up to 2x your storage on Business', 'Classic access ends November 16, 2026'
'All users, regardless of plan, receive free SFTP access', 'We are currently load testing our new SFTP connection option'
